steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p0_join_teams (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, rank_of_team INT) ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE TABLE p0_join_users (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, team_id INT, active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1) ENGINE=InnoDB
INSERT INTO p0_join_teams (id, name, rank_of_team) VALUES (1, 'red', 5), (2, 'blue', 9)
INSERT INTO p0_join_users (id, name, team_id, active) VALUES (1, 'ada', 1, 1), (2, 'grace', 2, 0), (3, 'linus', 1, 0)
SELECT u.id FROM p0_join_users u JOIN p0_join_teams t ON t.id = u.team_id AND t.name = 'red' ORDER BY u.id
SELECT u.id FROM p0_join_users u JOIN p0_join_teams t ON t.id = u.team_id AND u.active = 1 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT u.id, t.name FROM p0_join_users u LEFT JOIN p0_join_teams t ON t.id = u.team_id AND t.name = 'red' ORDER BY u.id
SELECT u.id FROM p0_join_users u JOIN p0_join_teams t ON t.id = u.team_id AND t.rank_of_team > 6 ORDER BY u.id
SELECT u.id FROM p0_join_users u JOIN p0_join_teams t ON t.id = u.team_id AND t.name = 'red' AND u.active = 1 ORDER BY u.id
